title: Plan-review seat output (Codex backend)
description: The final message of a Codex-backed plan reviewer (round 1 full pass, rounds >=2 targeted re-review via resume). sf-codex renders it to plan-review-r<N>.md in the exact review-plan/SKILL.md Step 4 layout and enforces overall_risk = max severity and the rubric's verdict rule.

overall_risk.description: Highest finding severity; NONE when there are no findings.

id.description: Stable id within this review, e.g. P-1. Keep ids stable across rounds.

plan_says.description: What the plan proposes (quote or paraphrase).

evidence.description: Specific file paths, code references, or codebase patterns.

recommendation.description: Concrete action; when the remedy cannot cite live code, the most plausible remedy plus the exact check that would settle it.

unverified.description: True when the recommendation could not be verified against live code or vendor evidence (the UNVERIFIED marker).

clean_dimensions.description: Dimensions with no findings, e.g. "3.4 — Security Implications".

open_questions.description: Questions the plan does not answer that must be resolved before implementation. Empty when none.
